zh: 我昨天在超市看见他了。
old_en: I saw him at the supermarket yesterday.
new_en: I saw him at the supermarket yesterday.

old_en: Look at this menu, please.
new_en: Take a look at this menu, please.

zh: 孩子们正在客厅看电视。
old_en: The kids are watching TV in the living room.
new_en: The kids are watching TV in the living room.

old_en: We're watching the game right now.
new_en: We're watching the game right now.

zh: 我们昨晚看了一部电影。
old_en: We watched a movie last night.
new_en: We watched a movie last night.

old_en: Come and have a look at this photo.
new_en: Come and look at this photo.

old_en: He glanced at his watch.
new_en: He looked at his watch.

zh: 我下午要去医院看医生。
old_en: I'm going to the hospital to see the doctor this afternoon.
new_en: I'm going to the hospital to see a doctor this afternoon.

old_en: She went to the hospital to see a doctor today.
new_en: She went to the hospital to see a doctor today.

zh: 她坐在窗边看着窗外发呆。
old_en: She sat by the window watching the view outside.
new_en: She sat by the window staring out.

old_en: Did you watch the game yesterday?
new_en: Did you watch the game yesterday?

old_en: They went to see the play tonight.
new_en: They are going to see a play tonight.

old_en: I saw a rainbow outside just now.
new_en: I saw a rainbow outside just now.

zh: 我在路上看见一只小狗。
old_en: I saw a little dog on my way home.
new_en: I saw a little dog on my way home.

old_en: I saw Old Wang on the street.
new_en: I saw Old Wang on the street.

old_en: Please look at this document.
new_en: Please look at this document.

old_en: She often watches documentaries.
new_en: She likes to watch documentaries.

old_en: He looked at the screen without saying a word.
new_en: He stared at the screen without speaking.

zh: 你帮我看着孩子一会儿。
old_en: Watch the child for me for a while.
new_en: Can you watch the child for a while?

old_en: Please look after my luggage while I get the drinks.
new_en: Please look after my luggage while I get the drinks.
